answer: Picture a velvet rope at the door: a new agent only enters if an established member sponsors it by locking part of their own stake. If the newcomer is later caught as a duplicate, the sponsor's lock is slashed at the next dawn settlement. A Sybil farmer must either buy many real sponsors or burn their own reputation, so each fake costs a forfeited bond, and the ledger marks the guilty sponsor in dull umber for all to see.
